thread:
Clara Nguyen: FinBot just flagged a sudden $62k spike on the customer-prod billing account for 2026-05-12. looks like GPU hours spiked between 02:00-05:00 UTC. can infra confirm if this was customer traffic or internal benchmarking? :thinking:
FinBot: Alert: account customer-prod exceeded daily GPU threshold (500% of baseline). Top SKUs: nvidia-a100-80gb (on-demand). Billing export: https://console.cloud/billing/exports/customer-prod-2026-05-12.csv
Omar Singh: checking logs — i see a scheduled benchmark job (benchmarks/weekly_perf) ran in prod night window. job definition references billing_account_id=acct-prod in terraform variable that was recently rolled out to staging too. looks like the staging cron accidentally pointed to prod.
Rajiv Menon: yep that cron is on a shared Jenkins master. someone updated the param last week when onboarding a contractor. i can pull the run IDs and instance IDs. want the raw instance list or an aggregated cost report for finance?
Clara Nguyen: finance needs line-item IDs + timestamps and a short narrative for the vendor case. also need an internal chargeback proposal: transfer to staging/benchmarks project. can we get both?
Omar Singh: running this BigQuery to map billing export to our internal tags — run it on company_billing.gcp_billing_export:

`````
SELECT
  invoice_month,
  IFNULL(labels.environment,'UNLABELED') AS env,
  labels.owner AS owner,
  sku_description,
  SUM(cost) AS total_cost
FROM `company_billing.gcp_billing_export_v1_*`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-05'
  AND DATE(usage_start_time) = '2026-05-12'
  AND LOWER(sku_description) LIKE '%a100%'
GROUP BY invoice_month, env, owner, sku_description
ORDER BY total_cost DESC
LIMIT 100;
`````

Omar Singh: will attach CSV to /shared/finance-temp/prod-benchmarks-20260512.csv in 10m.
FinBot: Note: Billing export snapshot time 2026-06-02T04:15:00Z. Recommended steps: vendor case with lineItemIds, internal chargeback journal entry, remediation to cron config.
Leah Turner: finance: provisional approval for a charge transfer to staging allowed if infra provides the line-item CSV + manager approval from EngInfra and DevEx. final sign-off after vendor response.
Rajiv Menon: exported list includes 184 instances and lineItemIds. uploaded at https://files.internal/shared/finance-temp/prod-benchmarks-20260512.csv. Added a notes column: run_owner, job_id, instance_type, fallback_pool (if any).
Clara Nguyen: perfect. i'll draft the vendor support case and include the CSV + explanation: "Benchmarks scheduled in staging mistakenly pointed to prod billing due to cron param change; request invoice reallocation or credit." will cc legal.
Leah Turner: please also include estimated customer impact and confirm that no external customer SLAs were affected. if customers were affected we may need to revert credits differently.
Omar Singh: confirmed no external traffic — all runs originated from service accounts bench-runner@redwood.internal. i've opened a PR to lock billing_account_id in the Jenkins pipeline and added a preflight step that validates the account ID against environment. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/817
Clara Nguyen: can we also add a short-term automated alert: when daily GPU spend in prod > $20k and job label contains "benchmark" notify #billing-alerts + eng-infra? want faster detection.
Leah Turner: approved. finance will sign off on alert thresholds. also request a monthly audit of cross-account billing events for any untagged GPU usage.
Rajiv Menon: adding the alert rule and the audit query job. i'll update this thread when the PR merges and when the vendor case is opened.
Clara Nguyen: thanks all — leaning on infra to get the CSV + PR link so i can file the vendor case before EOD. :thumbsup:
